title: BeBeo Gallery Hero Background Config Contract
description: Hop dong cau hinh nen Hero (tuy chon). Duoc scripts/validate-content.mjs kiem tra khi build neu file src/_data/heroBackground.json ton tai. Neu file khong ton tai, Hero dung nen truu tuong mac dinh (FR-006c) va khong co loi gi.

image.description: Duong dan tuong doi toi anh nen Hero trong src/assets/images/hero/. null hoac vang mat = dung nen truu tuong mac dinh.

filter.description: Kieu bo loc mau ap dung khi co image. Mac dinh 'tinted' neu vang mat nhung image co gia tri.

x-validation-notes: Neu file heroBackground.json khong ton tai: bo qua hoan toan, khong loi (khac voi albums.json/videos.json la bat buoc).

Neu file ton tai nhung 'image' tro toi duong dan khong co that tren dia luc build: KHONG chan build — shortcode heroBackground trong .eleventy.js MUST tu dong fallback ve nen truu tuong mac dinh (xem data-model.md).
'filter' chi co y nghia khi 'image' co gia tri; neu 'image' la null/vang mat thi 'filter' (neu co) bi bo qua.
